q: Nagaur's plier and hammer makers heat on furnace oil: what is the footprint per tonne?
title: Nagaur pliers and hammers: CO2 per tonne
short: Roughly 1.15 t CO2 per tonne of hand tools on today's factors. Nagaur's 55 or so units burn about 12 lakh litres of furnace oil a year, 86% of their energy, and use 1.9 million kWh to make about 4,200 t of tools, mostly pliers and hammers.
audience: Forging units in Basni and machining units in Loharpura, and the Jalandhar exporters they supply

ul: 41 forging units in Basni heat En-8 bar in oil fired furnaces and forge it under drop or spring hammers.
14 machining units in Loharpura grind, polish and assemble on electric machines.
No unit does both, so each half carries a different footprint.
Pliers and hammers are about 75% of output. Several units supply Jalandhar's exporters rather than export directly.

p: Almost all the furnace oil is burnt in Basni; Loharpura's footprint is mainly electricity. A forging unit's CO2 per tonne will be well above the cluster's 1.15 t, and a machining unit's well below. When a Jalandhar buyer asks for a figure, give your own, with the step you do named.

ul: Forging furnaces are locally built of clay brick and mud with local burners and poor insulation.
Better insulation, a proper burner, air preheating from waste heat and temperature control: about 30% less oil.
Furnace auxiliaries such as right-sized motors and dampers: about 10%.

ol: Furnace oil litres from each invoice, and stock at month end.
Tonnes of bar forged and tonnes of finished tools dispatched.
Rejects: the study estimates 4 to 5%, but nobody records them.

example.title: Cluster and an average forging unit (estimate)
lines: Furnace oil: 12,00,000 litres x 2.97 kg = 3,564 t CO2
Electricity: 1.9 million kWh x 0.675 = 1,283 t CO2
Total about 4,850 t / 4,200 t of tools = 1.15 t CO2 per tonne
Average forging unit: 29,270 litres a year = 87 t CO2; a 30% furnace saving cuts about 8,780 litres and 26 t
example.note: Quantities from the UNIDO and TERI cluster brief, which itself gives 1.1 t per tonne. The per unit split assumes all oil is burnt in the 41 forging units.

senseible: The calculators give a per tonne figure from your oil and power; Senseible can read the oil invoices and bills behind it when a Jalandhar buyer wants records.
